title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: migrate environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
summary: The briefing's migration paths, integration API, prerequisites and preview restrictions are supported by Microsoft Learn, and its status and target dates match the roadmap. It correctly distinguishes unpublished migration licensing and pricing from the documented capacity requirements.

claims.claim: Self-service migration moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: Migration is performed separately for each environment in a Lifecycle Services project.
claims.quote: Migration is performed separately for each environment in a Lifecycle Services project.

claims.claim: Migration does not migrate the Lifecycle Services project itself.
claims.quote: It doesn't migrate the Lifecycle Services project itself.

claims.claim: Migration changes the control plane by updating environment metadata across Microsoft services.
claims.quote: Migration changes the control plane that manages the environment. The process updates environment metadata across Microsoft services so that lifecycle operations are managed through the Power Platform admin center instead of Lifecycle Services.

claims.quote: The database isn't moved, and the environment infrastructure isn't materially changed.

claims.quote: Review [finance and operations storage capacity](/en-us/power-platform/admin/finance-operations-storage-capacity), and free or purchase enough capacity to clear the deficit.

claims.claim: The capacity page says deleting unneeded environments and data can address a storage capacity deficit.
claims.quote: If your organization has a storage capacity deficit, you can delete unneeded environments and data or buy more capacity.

claims.claim: Buying additional capacity is another documented way to address a storage capacity deficit.
claims.quote: If your organization has a storage capacity deficit, you can delete unneeded environments and data or buy more capacity.

claims.claim: The storage capacity page says exceeding storage entitlements currently does not affect service availability.
claims.quote: Currently, exceeding storage entitlements doesn't affect the availability of the service.

claims.quote: Future environment provisioning is based on available Power Platform capacity instead of Lifecycle Services environment slots.

claims.where: controls[2].governs; Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The finance and operations environment must be linked to a Power Platform environment before migration.
claims.quote: Link the environment to a Power Platform environment.

claims.claim: Dual-write does not have to be enabled to migrate.
claims.quote: You don't have to enable dual-write to migrate an environment.

claims.claim: The migration page does not name a required Lifecycle Services project role.
claims.quote: Searched: migrate Lifecycle Services project role administrator. Read the migration article, including prerequisites, migration steps and failed-check resolutions; it specifies linked Power Platform environment administration but no Lifecycle Services project role.

claims.claim: No API for starting this Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center migration is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: migrate Lifecycle Services Power Platform API migration start; Lifecycle Services migration API control plane. Read the migration article and returned migration-step excerpts; they document the UI, not an API to start this migration.

claims.claim: No API for the finance and operations storage capacity report is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: finance and operations storage capacity report API PowerShell; Power Platform API capacity finance operations. Read storage capacity and searched Create a daily capacity report for finance, operations and capacity; its documented types are Database, File and Log.

claims.claim: Migration starts in Lifecycle Services at project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Migrate to Power Platform Admin Center.
claims.quote: open the project that contains the environment. ... In the **Environments** section ... select **Full details**. ... expand **Power Platform migration (Preview)**. ... Select **Migrate to Power Platform Admin Center**.

claims.claim: The finance and operations capacity report is at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Capacity add-ons > Finance and Operations.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select **Licensing**. ... In the **Licensing** pane, select **Capacity add-ons**. ... Select **Finance and Operations**.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table and prerequisite labels
claims.claim: The linked-environment check is at Lifecycle Services > project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Power Platform environment is linked.
claims.quote: open the project that contains the environment. ... In the **Environments** section ... select **Full details**. ... expand **Power Platform migration (Preview)**. ... **Power Platform environment is linked**.

claims.claim: GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails is the documented Dataverse request to verify integration status.
claims.quote: The API can be used during troubleshooting to verify that the Power Platform integration is enabled for an environment. ... GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails

claims.claim: The Dataverse call checks integration rather than starting migration, returning linked finance and operations environment details or an error when it is not linked.
claims.quote: the API returns the Microsoft Entra tenant and environment details of the finance and operations apps environment. ... If the environment isn't linked ... the following error is returned ... Dataverse instance isn't integrated with finance and operations.

claims.claim: The integration article does not specify which role may call RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails.
claims.quote: Searched: RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails role permissions. Read Enable Power Platform integration, including the complete runtime API section; no caller role is specified.

claims.claim: The migration completion indicator is Migration status showing Migrated.
claims.quote: Wait until **Migration status** is **Migrated**, and then select **Open in Power Platform Admin Center**.

claims.claim: No new data location is documented for this control-plane migration.
claims.quote: Searched: migrate Lifecycle Services database region location. Read the migration article and unified admin overview; this migration says the database is not moved. Results about project geography and zone-redundancy migrations describe different operations.

claims.claim: The existing finance and operations storage report shows organizational usage against licence entitlement, with tenant-level and environment-level reporting.
claims.quote: The finance and operations storage capacity report shows how much finance and operations storage your organization is using compared with how much its license entitles it to. ... Storage reporting covers usage at the tenant and environment level.
